name: neovim-expert
title: Neovim Expert
description: Ask questions about your Neovim configuration using Raycast AI. Search plugins, keybindings, LSP setup, and more with @neovim-expert.
author: coleconrad

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: Neovim Config Directory
preferences.description: Path to your Neovim configuration directory. If not set, auto-detects ~/.config/nvim.

commands.name: open-config
commands.title: Open Neovim Config
commands.subtitle: Neovim Expert
commands.description: Open your Neovim configuration directory in Finder

tools.name: getConfigSummary
tools.title: Get Config Summary
tools.description: Get a high-level overview of the Neovim configuration including detected plugin manager, key files, and directory structure.
tools.instructions: Use this tool first before answering any question. It tells you what plugin manager is used, what key files exist, and the overall structure of the config.

tools.name: listConfigFiles
tools.title: List Config Files
tools.description: List all files in the Neovim configuration directory or a subdirectory.
tools.instructions: Use this tool to see the file tree. Optionally scope to a subdirectory like 'lua/plugins' to narrow the listing.

tools.name: readConfigFile
tools.title: Read Config File
tools.description: Read the contents of a specific Neovim configuration file by its relative path.
tools.instructions: Use this tool to read a specific file. The filePath must be relative to the config directory (e.g., 'lua/plugins/go.lua', 'init.lua').

tools.name: listPlugins
tools.title: List Plugins
tools.description: List all installed or configured Neovim plugins with best-effort parsing of the plugin manager format.
tools.instructions: Use this tool to get a list of plugins. It auto-detects the plugin manager (lazy.nvim, packer, vim-plug) and parses accordingly. Falls back to scanning Lua files for plugin spec patterns.

tools.name: searchConfig
tools.title: Search Config
tools.description: Search across all Neovim configuration files for a term, returning matching lines with file paths and line numbers.
tools.instructions: Use this tool to grep across config files. Supports optional file pattern filtering (e.g., '*.lua'). Case-insensitive. Use for finding specific settings, options, or references.

tools.name: searchKeybindings
tools.title: Search Keybindings
tools.description: Find keybinding definitions across the Neovim configuration, scanning for vim.keymap.set, map/nmap/imap commands, and lazy.nvim keys tables.
tools.instructions: Use this tool to find keybinding definitions. Optionally filter by key or description. Returns mode, key, action, and source file for each binding.
